# Restructuring Requirements Quality Checklist: Flatten Workspace Into Repository Root

**Purpose**: Validate the requirements quality (completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, coverage) of spec 005-workspace-root-move and its plan — "unit tests for English" on the restructuring requirements, NOT a test of the implementation.

**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [research.md](../research.md)

**Second review pass (2026-09-02, reviewer adjudication)**: reviewer's category findings resolved five further items — CHK011 (baseline capture defined by tasks.md T003), CHK012 (FR-009 ordering defines PR 2 sequencing), CHK026 (rebase guidance mandated by tasks.md T018), CHK029 (tasks.md T005 pre-commit purity gate), CHK031 (no symlinks/submodules/case collisions exist in the tree). **43/49 items closed; 6 remain open as acknowledged residual risks — the requirements gate is passed.**

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK026 - Is the in-flight-branch rebase scenario backed by a requirement (what "only path-level conflicts" means, who verifies it), or only by expectation? [Coverage → resolved, Spec §Edge Cases + research D10 + tasks.md T018 PR-description guidance]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is coverage defined for contributors who clone or branch during the transition window between PR 1 and PR 2 merges? [Gap, Scenario Coverage]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are requirements defined for concurrent open PRs whose diffs touch `leiden/` paths at merge time (stale-base handling)? [Gap, Scenario Coverage]
- [x] CHK029 - Does the spec define a remediation requirement if rename detection fails for a specific file (delete+add pair instead of rename) — is there an exception path for FR-002/SC-002? [Gap → resolved, tasks.md T005 pre-commit purity hard gate with stop-and-restage rule — a committed failure cannot occur]
- [x] CHK030 - Are case-insensitive filesystems addressed (macOS/Windows checkouts where `leiden/` and root-level paths could collide or fold), given the nested dir shares its name with the repo? [Gap → out of scope: no case-variant names exist in the tree (verified); FR-003 excludes unrelated changes]
- [x] CHK031 - Are symlinks, submodules, or special files inside the workspace either addressed or explicitly declared out of scope? [Gap → resolved, review pass 2: repository verified to contain no symlinks, submodules, or case-variant paths; declared out of scope]
- [x] CHK032 - Is the disposability requirement scoped precisely — is only `target/` declared disposable, and are any other cache locations enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, research D7]
- [ ] CHK033 - Are partial-failure requirements defined for an interrupted move (local worktree half-moved — is there a defined clean-restart procedure or requirement)? [Gap, Edge Case/Recovery]
- [x] CHK034 - Is the edge-case mandate to update "scripts, editor workspaces, CI job working directories" supported by an inventory requirement (how are those tools discovered, is discovery itself a requirement)? [Completeness → satisfied, Spec §Edge Cases + research D4/D5 inventory]
- [ ] CHK035 - Are requirements defined for path-length or tooling limits that differ between the nested and flattened layouts (deep `crates/leiden/...` paths getting shorter vs root getting denser)? [Gap, Edge Case]
